flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/ff6600 then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, stop and report it.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Open the color picker from the swatch next to the search field.
Press Tab through at least three controls unless the swatch gets focus sooner.
If it gets focus, @v16:"press Enter".
Verify the color spectrum and hue slider appear.

summary:
The test assumed that the visible orange swatch had received keyboard focus. The shown page state instead indicates focus or text selection in the color search field, while the swatch was not established as a keyboard control.
Update the keyboard check to identify the actual focused control before issuing Enter, and mark this scenario as unsupported when the swatch is not tabbable rather than claiming it received focus.
one_liner: The run treated focus in the search field as focus on the color swatch, so it could not complete the keyboard-only check.
